AffectednessDetail.description:
The server's sentence for each ``AffectednessFailure``: the ``detail`` of an
affectedness check and of an unavailable ``affectedness`` capability.
enum: BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED: no affectedness adapter is verified against a deployed Trustify; trustify-mcp ac8955f calls /api/v2 routes Trustify removed in v0.5.0 (ADR 0003). Affectedness is not checked.
The affectedness source could not be reached. Affectedness is not established.
The affectedness source did not answer within its time limit. Affectedness is not established.
The affectedness source refused this server's credentials. Affectedness is not established.
The affectedness source's tools differ from the pinned trustify-mcp surface. Affectedness is not established.
AffectednessDetail.title: AffectednessDetail

AffectednessFailure.description:
Why the affectedness source gave no answer.

``blocked_unverified``: no adapter is verified against a deployed Trustify, so none
is called; the other members are the failures a verified adapter reports.
AffectednessFailure.title: AffectednessFailure

AffectednessRequest.description:
One CVE against one package version. A product name is not accepted: no Trustify
tool maps a name to a package.
AffectednessRequest.title: AffectednessRequest

description:
The published answer to an affectedness check: always ``unknown``, with the failure
that kept applicability from being established and the server's sentence for it.
title: AffectednessCheck
